notes.title: Story Patch
notes.content:
This is our first patch after attending [b]Nordic Game Conference[/b]! We've gotten some great feedback, that inspired this first set of targeted improvements and fixes. Next we'll tweak the dialogues more, fix issues and add content! Thank you for playing!

[h1]Story[/h1]
Added several key NPC that will play a role moving forward:
• [b]John [/b]- An adventurer who thinks the treasure might be the cause behind creatures acting oddly
• [b]Gavin [/b]- The  leader of the adventurers, with his eyes set on the treasure
• [b]Erwyn [/b]- The awoken who left the notes in the tutorial, who holds some answers

Also added some story drops:
• A dead awoken who left a note with directions to Erwyn
• Another Ancient Tablet holding ancient lore to be found in Gouraija Forest

[h1]General Gameplay[/h1]
• Slowmo when menu opened and interacting
• Limited your movement right before gaining an ability to stop you from movement dashing away

[h1]Miscellaneous[/h1]
• Increased UI size by 15% on Steamdeck to make text easier to read
• Improved insert gem tutorial
• Added RT attack input preset

[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
• Fixed flickering barrels / crates
• Fixed intercept double charging
